Internal helper: a label's text, breaking only between its words

Source: R/tables.R
dot-jst_docx_keep_text.Rd

Ruling R55's measure (.jst_docx_stub_floor()) wraps a label onto two lines between its words, a parenthetical one word; Word also breaks after a hyphen and an en dash and between a parenthetical's words, and fills the first line as far as it goes, so "Wellbeing score (0-100)" in a narrowed stub broke after "(0-" (found on the S414 walk). Here a hyphen is Word's non-breaking hyphen (w:noBreakHyphen), as the true minus sign keeps a negative whole; the spaces inside parentheses are non-breaking; and an en dash is joined to what follows it (Session 415; Jeff: "Is there some way to have the entire parenthetical on the second line when wrapping is necessary?"). The text reads as before.

Usage

.jst_docx_keep_text(text)

Arguments

text

Character(1).

Value

The run's text elements, XML.
